has_orders: check if a list of orders contains all expected orders for a Diplomacy game
validate_pseudoorder_annotation_test: validate a pseudo-order annotation test string against a Diplomacy game state and sender
run_pseudoorder_annotation_test: run a pseudo-order annotation test on a list of pseudo-orders and return a boolean
PseudoOrderTestValidatorError: raise a PseudoOrderTestValidatorError exception when validating an invalid pseudo-order annotation test
PseudoOrderTestRuntimeError: raise a PseudoOrderTestRuntimeError exception when executing a pseudo-order annotation test fails
